_comment: Dynamic intake script for Richard Harris Law Firm. Sections evaluate top-to-bottom; a section appears when its `when` condition matches (field value regex or flag label regex — omit for always-on). Steps auto-complete when their `field` is covered by the live extraction pass, or when `autoAfter` seconds have elapsed since call start. The UI highlights the first incomplete step as the current beat.

steps.label: Greeting + agency disclosure
steps.text: Thank you for calling Richard Harris Law Firm — my name is ____. I help our attorneys with new case intake. Just so you know, I'm not an attorney, but everything you tell me goes straight to our legal team.

steps.label: Caller name + best contact
steps.text: Can I get your full name, and the best phone number or email to reach you?

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Tell me what happened — take your time, I'm listening.

steps.label: When it happened
steps.text: When did this happen — do you remember the date?

steps.label: Where it happened
steps.text: And where exactly did this happen?

steps.label: How it happened / fault
steps.text: Can you walk me through how it happened — do you know who was at fault?

steps.label: Police report
steps.text: Did the police come to the scene — is there a report?

steps.label: Insurance details
steps.text: Do you have insurance information for yourself or the other driver?

steps.label: Incident report
steps.text: Did you report it to the property owner or manager? Was an incident report made?

steps.label: Witnesses / photos
steps.text: Was anyone else there? Did you get photos of the scene or the hazard?

steps.label: Injuries
steps.text: I'm sorry you're dealing with this. What injuries did you suffer?

steps.label: Medical care
steps.text: Have you seen a doctor or gone to the ER? Are you still treating?

steps.label: Insurance contact
steps.text: Has any insurance company contacted you? Important: please don't give them a recorded statement before we talk.

steps.label: Other attorney
steps.text: Have you spoken with or hired any other attorney about this?

steps.label: Recap + confirm contact
steps.text: Let me make sure I have this right… and is this the best number to reach you?

steps.label: Next step
steps.text: Here's what happens next: I'm passing everything to an attorney for review — consultations are completely free, and you pay nothing unless we recover money for you. Do you have any questions for me?

steps.label: Caller has counsel
steps.text: Since you're already working with an attorney, I'd recommend directing questions to them — but let me note your details and have our team confirm whether we can help.

steps.label: Immediate danger
steps.text: If you're in danger or need medical help right now, please call 911 first. I'm also getting my supervisor on the line right away.
